integration_issues.issue: RCA: the one-line fix in iteration-110 patched the quote-builder useEffect (line 700) to read `i.menu_item_id || i.product_id || i.product?.id`, but the useEffect iterates `cart.items` (the hydrated array), NOT the raw guest-cart. hydrateGuest() at line 362-371 pushes food rows as {id, product_id: it.product_id, quantity, module, product: s, line_total, restaurant_id: s.restaurant_id} — it NEVER propagates `menu_item_id` from the raw line. For the review-spec payload (`{module:'food', restaurant_id:'burger_hub_in', menu_item_id:'burger_hub_in_crispy_wings', snapshot:{name,price,currency}}`), the hydrated row has `product_id: undefined`, no `menu_item_id`, snapshot has no `.id`, so `i.menu_item_id || i.product_id || i.product?.id` → undefined, the filter on line 705 drops the row, items.length === 0 → setQuote(null) → zero network traffic. Additionally `restaurant_id: s.restaurant_id` is undefined because our seed snapshot doesn't include it (and the real addFoodItem code DOES write it, but only on production add path). Verified empirically: body contains '478' and 'Gratuit', zero /cart/quote hits. FIX OPTIONS: (a) in hydrateGuest add `menu_item_id: it.menu_item_id` and `restaurant_id: s.restaurant_id || it.restaurant_id` to the pushed food row, OR (b) change the quote builder to iterate raw guest-cart items (readGuest().items) instead of hydrated cart.items. (a) is a 2-line surgical fix.

rca of the issue: Iteration-110 identified the symptom correctly (quote builder reading product_id but guest cart stored menu_item_id) but applied the fix on the wrong layer. The useEffect at BakedContexts.jsx:685 iterates `cart.items` (populated by hydrateGuest), not the raw localStorage guest-cart. hydrateGuest at line 362-371 explicitly pushes food rows with `{id, product_id: it.product_id, quantity, module, product: s, line_total, restaurant_id: s.restaurant_id}` — no `menu_item_id` field is carried through. So for the review-spec payload where the raw line uses `menu_item_id` (and the snapshot doesn't contain `id` or `restaurant_id`), hydrated row has: menu_item_id=undefined, product_id=undefined, product.id=undefined, restaurant_id=undefined. The quote builder's new expression `i.menu_item_id || i.product_id || i.product?.id` therefore evaluates to undefined, the filter drops the row, items.length is 0, setQuote(null) is called and no network request is issued. UI falls back to the quote-less math (delivery=0 → 'Gratuit', total=subtotal=₹478.00). Mitigation: add `menu_item_id: it.menu_item_id` and `restaurant_id: s.restaurant_id || it.restaurant_id` to the hydrateGuest push for non-shop rows (lines 362-371). Reproduction: see seed_data_creation; open /food desktop or /cart mobile; inspect Network — zero /api/cart/quote hits; UI shows ₹478 / Gratuit.
